intent: Show how cyclists' and drivers' traffic-law compliance rates compare, and convey how close the two groups are.

requirements.question: How close are cyclists' and drivers' traffic-law compliance rates?
Are all data marks declared by G0 present in the required state or states?

scope.selection: all data rows (table has no role column)

units.claim: Cyclists' and drivers' traffic-law compliance rates are close: 88% vs 85%, a 3-percentage-point gap.
accept: two bars of nearly equal length
units.evidence: Two bars of nearly equal length, or a comparison showing a 3-point gap.

units.claim: All 2 required bar marks or stacked segments appear in the final chart.
accept: all 2 required data marks are visible
the complete required mark set is present in the final chart
reject: omitting any required bar or stacked segment
replacing missing marks with a summary total or subtitle
units.evidence: G0 data-row coverage is rendered as a complete set of identifiable bar marks.

notes: Narration compares biking with 'any other time'; the table only compares cyclists vs drivers. Treated as a chart-only comparison.

g0_data_completeness.selection: all data rows (table has no role column)
